sentences.text: On going through the allegations made in the complaint and on  perusal of the investigation papers, it reveals that the applicant was  merely driving the car at the relevant time.

So far as the permanent  residence of the applicant is concerned, learned counsel for the ::: Uploaded on - 03/06/2019 ::: Downloaded on - 04/06/2019 05:19:46  ba521.19  -2-  applicant has placed on record the copies of Aaddhar card, election  card and bank pass book.
In view of the same, I am inclined to grant  bail to the applicant on certain conditions.
ORDER  I. Application is hereby allowed.

II. The applicant Vitthal s/o Dattarao Bajad, in connection with crime No. 58 of 2019 registered with Phulambri police station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 of IPC and under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount on following conditions:-
a) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b) The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 8.00 a.m. to 11.00 a.m. till filing of charge sheet.

( V. K. JADHAV, J.)
